title: The cities of the Mesopotamian gods
scope: Lower Mesopotamia: Sumerian-language, Akkadian-language and Babylonian traditions. A selected evidence catalogue, not an exhaustive ancient god list.
method: Birth, creation, conception, childhood, genealogy and cult association are separate claims. Null origin coordinates are deliberate. Documentary attestation is not the date of a deity’s first invention. A city may have many gods and a god many cities.
